import pulp

prob = pulp.LpProblem("minimize_boat", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
boat = pulp.LpVariable("boat", lowBound=0, cat="Integer")  # boat
canoe = pulp.LpVariable("canoe", lowBound=0, cat="Integer")  # canoe

# Objective: minimize total amount of time
prob += 20 * boat + 40 * canoe

# Constraints
prob += boat + canoe >= 300  # total at least 300
prob += boat <= 12  # boat at most 12
prob += -0.6 * boat + 0.4 * canoe >= 0  # canoe at least 0.6 of total (60%)

prob.solve(pulp.getSolver("HiGHS", msg=False))
print("Status:", pulp.LpStatus[prob.status])
print("Objective:", pulp.value(prob.objective))
print("boat =", pulp.value(boat))
print("canoe =", pulp.value(canoe))
